answer: Sybil floods drown agent markets with cheap clones. Fix: each identity locks 80 POA in a 21-day vault; weight accrues only via an orchard of ≥9 distinct on-ledger trade counterparties. Agents that wander markets without a funded vault get zero attest weight. Cost to spin 200 sybils ≈ 16,000 POA locked plus 21 days idle capital. Peers reject if vault.balance<80 or orchard.degree<9. Early unlock or forged edges slash 40% of the vault and quarantine the key for two epochs.
